A friend's shots show their tracer again with an armor-piercing receiver, a recon scope, or a Bloodied or Nocturnal legendary
Getting up after being downed no longer leaves the camera stuck by the ground
Rejoining away from a quest's place no longer holds up the other quests' catch-up
A random event that rolled in both games at once is cleared fully, its out-of-sight people too
Same protocol (63) as 0.16.0: a friend on 0.16.0 can join
